blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: External-memory systems extend language-model applications beyond a context window, but their quality depends critically on the model executing the write path: deciding what to retain, how precisely to represent it, and how new evidence should update persistent state. Existing frameworks typically place a general-purpose large language model behind framework-specific prompts. This raises serving cost, and a writer specialized for one protocol does not transfer directly to another; a unified model that can operate across established memory frameworks remains largely unexplored. We present Hy-Memory-30B-A3B, a compact long-term-memory writer trained across Mem0, MemOS, and Hy-Memory. Memory On-Policy Distillation teaches framework-specific write protocols on student-generated states; Memory RL then optimizes downstream answerability using dense per-chunk probes, attributed cross-chunk rewards, over-storage controls, and chunk-level GRPO. Carrying policy-written banks across windows keeps training aligned with deployment. On fixed 20% benchmark subsamples, Hy-Memory-30B-A3B ranks first on all four evaluated harnesses, including held-out EverMemOS, with a 55.49% macro average versus 54.62% for Claude Opus 5.
blocks.zh: 外部记忆系统将语言模型应用扩展出上下文窗口之外,但其质量关键取决于执行写入路径的模型:决定保留什么,如何准确代表它,以及新证据应如何更新持久性状态. 现有框架通常将通用大语言模式置于具体框架提示后。 这提高了服务成本,一个协议的专用写作机不会直接转移到另一个协议;一个可以跨已确立的内存框架运行的统一模式基本上仍未被探索. 我们向大家介绍Hy-Memory-30B-A3B,他是经过Mem0,MemOS和Hy-Memory培训的紧凑的长期记忆作家. Memory On-Political Distillation 教给学生生成状态的针对框架的写作协议;Minemory RL然后利用密集的每圆柱探测器优化下游的可答性,归属跨圆柱奖励,超存储控制,以及块级GRPO. 跨窗口携带政策书写银行使培训与部署保持一致。 在固定的20%基准子样本中,Hy-Memory-30B-A3B在所有4个被评价的带子上排名第一,包括被搁置的EverMemOS,其宏观平均值为55.49%,而克洛德·奥普斯为54.62%.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
A long-term memory system for an LLM application usually contains three functional stages:
(1) a writer converts an interaction into persistent memory operations;
(2) a retriever selects records relevant to a future query; and
(3) a reader or answer model uses the retrieved records to respond.

Systems such as Mem0, A-MEM, MemoryOS, and MemOS have expanded the design space of persistent memory through extraction, consolidation, hierarchical paging, linking, versioning, and lifecycle management ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Kang et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . Benchmarks such as LoCoMo and LongMemEval have also shown that long-term memory is not a single retrieval problem: it includes precise extraction, multi-session composition, temporal reasoning, knowledge updates, and abstention ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: Mem0, A-MEM, MemoryOS, MemOS 等系统通过提取,整合,分级寻呼,连接,改版,以及生命周期管理,扩大了持久性内存的设计空间(Chhikara等人,2025年;徐等人,2025年;Kang等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年). LoCoMo和LongMemEval等基准也表明,长期记忆不是一个单一的检索问题:它包括精确提取,多会组成,时间推理,知识更新,以及弃权(Maharana等人,2024年;Wu等人,2025年).

blocks.en: Despite this progress, the write policy is commonly implemented by placing a general-purpose LLM behind a long, framework-specific prompt. That model must simultaneously distinguish durable user information from greetings, assistant suggestions, and transient text; preserve exact names, numbers, versions, dates, paths, and other identifying details; represent a state transition without losing either the new state or what it replaced; reconcile new evidence with retrieved memories already in the bank; and emit valid operations under the framework’s schema and control flow.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但写作政策通常通过将通用LLM放在一个长长的、针对具体框架的提示后面来执行。 这一模式必须同时区分耐久的用户信息与问候、助理建议和瞬间文本;保留确切的名称、数字、版本、日期、路径和其他识别细节;代表状态过渡,而不失去新状态或它所取代的东西;调和新证据与已经存放在银行中的已检索记忆;以及释放框架的策略和控制流下的有效操作。

blocks.en: The framework cannot recover information that the writer omitted, and a powerful downstream reader cannot reliably infer a fact that was never stored. Conversely, indiscriminately storing everything increases cost and retrieval interference. The desired writer is therefore not a generic summarizer: it is a policy for changing an external state under a long-horizon downstream objective.
blocks.zh: 框架无法恢复作者省略的信息,强大的下游读者也无法可靠地推断一个从未存储的事实. 相反,不加区别地储存一切会增加成本和检索干扰。 因此,理想的写作者不是一般的总结:这是在远视下游目标下改变外部状态的政策.

blocks.en: Recent work has begun to train memory operations with reinforcement learning. Memory-R1 trains a memory manager and an answer agent with final-answer rewards ( Yan et al., 2025 ) . MemAgent learns recurrent textual compression from a terminal verifier ( Yu et al., 2026 ) . Mem- α \alpha combines downstream QA correctness with format, compression, and operation-quality rewards ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . MemCoE explicitly identifies sparse outcome reward as a weakness and adds guideline-aligned process feedback ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . These studies establish that memory behavior is learnable rather than fixed. They also expose a remaining problem: a final answer score usually supervises an entire sequence of heterogeneous memory actions, even though only a few actions supplied the evidence—or caused the failure.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作已经开始以强化学习来训练记忆操作. Memory-R1训练一名内存管理者和答题代理,获得最终的答题奖励(Yan等人,2025年). MemAgent从终端验证器中学习经常性文字压缩(Yu等人,2026年). Mem-α\α结合下游QA正确度与格式,压缩,操作质量奖励(Wang等人,2025年). MemCoE明确指出,微弱的结果奖励是一个弱点,并增加了对准进程反馈(徐等人,2026年)。 这些研究确定记忆行为可以学习而不是固定. 他们也暴露了一个遗留的问题:最终的回答分数通常会监督一系列不同的记忆动作,尽管只有少数动作提供了证据——或者导致了失败.

blocks.en: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B focuses on this credit-assignment problem while preserving compatibility with existing memory frameworks. Our contributions are: • A framework-integrated memory writer. Hy3-30B-A3B replaces the LLM inside Mem0, MemOS, and Hy-Memory without moving their memory logic into a custom model architecture. • State-distribution-aligned training. OPD and RL both execute the policy inside the actual harness, and later writes observe banks produced by earlier policy outputs. • Failure-surface reward data. Training questions are constructed from concrete write failures, including omission, lost specificity, semantic inversion, stale-state confusion, secondary-fact loss, and over-storage. • Attributed, non-binary feedback. Local probes provide dense per-chunk evidence, while cross-chunk outcome questions use gold facts to map recovered evidence back to source chunks. • Chunk-level policy optimization. Advantages are normalized among rollouts at the same chunk position rather than over whole trajectories, so one rollout can be credited at one chunk and penalized at another. Each rollout casts one vote per chunk even when a framework makes multiple LLM calls. • Cross-harness and OOD results. Hy-Memory-30B-A3B ranks first on Mem0, Hy-Memory, MemOS, and held-out EverMemOS, averaging 55.49% across the four harnesses versus 54.62% for Claude Opus 5.
blocks.zh: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B专注于这一信用分配问题,同时保持与现有内存框架的兼容性. 我们的贡献是: 一个框架综合记忆作家。 Hy3-30B-A3B取代了Mem0内部的LLM,MemOS,以及Hy-Memory不将其内存逻辑移入自定义模型架构. • 国家分配协调培训。 OPD和RL都在实际控制范围内执行政策, • 故障表面奖励数据。 培训问题是由具体写作失败造成的,包括遗漏、特异性丧失、语义颠倒、 Stale-state 混淆、二次事实损失和过度储存。 属性非二进制反馈. 当地的探测器提供了密集的每圆块证据,而跨圆块结果问题则利用黄金事实将回收的证据映射回源块. ——春克级政策优化. 在同一块位置的推出中,而不是在整个轨道上,优点是正常化的,因此一个推出可计入一个块,而另一个则受到处罚。 每次推出,每个块投一票,即使一个框架发出多次LLM呼叫。 • 交叉矛盾和OD结果。 Hy-Memory-30B-A3B在Mem0,Hy-Memory,MemOS和被搁置的Ever-MemOS上排名第一,平均在4个吊带上排行55.49%,而克劳德·奥普斯5则排行54.62%.

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 External memory systems and evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.1 外部记忆系统和评价

blocks.en: Mem0 uses incremental extraction and consolidation to maintain a persistent memory store ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) . A-MEM organizes memories as dynamically linked notes whose attributes and relationships evolve as new information arrives ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . MemoryOS introduces an operating-system-inspired hierarchical storage architecture that coordinates short-term, mid-term, and long-term personal memory through dialogue-chain FIFO and segmented page updates ( Kang et al., 2025 ) . MemOS treats memory as a managed system resource and emphasizes representation, scheduling, provenance, and lifecycle control ( Li et al., 2025 ) . These systems differ in schema and control flow, but all depend on an LLM to interpret new interactions and produce valid operations.
blocks.zh: Mem0使用增量提取和合并来维持一个持久的记忆库(Chhikara等人,2025年)。 A-MEM将记忆组织为动态关联的注释,其属性和关系随着新信息的到来而演变(徐等人,2025年). 内存 OS引入了一个操作系统启发的层次存储架构,通过对话链FIFO和分页更新协调短期,中期,长期的个人记忆(Kang等人,2025年). MemOS将内存视为一种管理下的系统资源,强调表现,调度,出处和生命周期控制(Li等人,2025年). 这些系统在计划和控制流上有所不同,但都依赖于LLM来解释新的相互作用并产生有效的操作.

blocks.en: DCPM argues that long-term memory should support more than surface recall: its dual-process architecture represents belief revisions, identity, schemas, latent intentions, and cross-domain abstractions in a capability hierarchy ( Fei et al., 2026b ) . This direction is complementary to ours. DCPM redesigns the memory architecture and its evolution process, whereas Hy-Memory-30B-A3B trains a reusable writer that operates inside several existing memory architectures without replacing them.
blocks.zh: DCPM认为,长期记忆应该比表面记忆更支持:其双进程架构代表信仰修订、身份认同、计划、潜在意图,以及能力等级的跨域抽象(Fei等人,2026年b). 这个方向是对我们的补充。 DCPM重新设计内存架构及其演化过程,而Hy-Memory-30B-A3B则训练一个在几个现有内存架构内运行而不替换的可重复使用的编剧.

blocks.en: LoCoMo evaluates conversations containing hundreds of turns and multiple sessions, with questions requiring single-hop, multi-hop, temporal, open-domain, and adversarial reasoning ( Maharana et al., 2024 ) . LongMemEval decomposes conversational memory into information extraction, multi-session reasoning, temporal reasoning, knowledge update, and abstention ( Wu et al., 2025 ) . Together, these benchmarks motivate evaluating the full memory pipeline rather than the fluency of an extracted summary.
blocks.zh: LoCoMo评价包含数百个回合和多个会话的对话,其中的问题需要单跳,多跳,时间,开放域,以及对抗推理(Maharana等人,2024年). LongMemEval将对话记忆分解为信息提取,多会推理,时间推理,知识更新,以及弃权(Wu等人,2025年). 这些基准加在一起,促使人们评价完整的内存管道,而不是所提取摘要的流利性。

blocks.en: Our work draws two conclusions from this literature. First, memory quality must be measured downstream, after retrieval. Second, a useful reward dataset must cover distinct failure modes rather than collapsing all memory behavior into one generic QA score.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作从这一文献中得出两个结论。 第一,内存质量必须在下游,检索后进行测量. 第二,一个有用的奖励数据集必须涵盖不同的失败模式,而不是将所有的内存行为都崩溃成一个通用的QA分数.

blocks.en: 2.2 Reinforcement learning for memory
blocks.zh: 2.2 加强记忆学习

blocks.en: There are two related but distinct lines of memory RL.
blocks.zh: 记忆RL有两条相关但截然不同的行.

blocks.en: MemAgent processes a long document in chunks, repeatedly overwrites a bounded textual memory, and applies a final verifiable answer reward to all generated conversations ( Yu et al., 2026 ) . This trains a model-native long-context mechanism, but the memory representation and inference loop are part of the learned architecture.
blocks.zh: MemAgent用块处理一个长的文档,反复覆盖一个受约束的文本内存,并对所有生成的对话应用最终可核查的答案奖励(Yu等人,2026年). 这训练了一种模型本土长文本机制,但内存表示和推论环路是学习到的架构的一部分.

blocks.en: Memory-R1 learns ADD, UPDATE, DELETE, and NOOP operations, and also trains an answer agent that filters retrieved memories ( Yan et al., 2025 ) . Mem- α \alpha formulates memory construction as a sequence of operations over a multi-component bank and combines global QA correctness with local format and semantic-validity rewards ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . MemCoE uses an induced guideline to construct denser process feedback because final answer rewards alone are sparse over long memory-evolution trajectories ( Xu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: Memory-R1学习了ADD,UPDATE,DELETE,和NOOP操作,还培训了一个过滤检索记忆的解答代理(Yan等人,2025年). Mem- α\ alpha 将内存构建作为多构件库的操作序列,并结合全球QA的正确性与本地格式和语义有效性奖励(Wang等人,2025年). MemCoE使用诱导准则构建更稠密的流程反馈,因为仅最后的答案奖励在漫长的内存进化轨迹中是稀有的(徐等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B belongs to the second line but differs in scope. It trains the writer only , keeps the reader fixed during reward computation, and targets multiple pre-existing harnesses rather than one newly designed memory architecture. If the writer and answer model are optimized together, a better answer can come from improved reading rather than improved memory. Table 1 summarizes the distinction.
blocks.zh: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B属于第二行,但范围不同. 它只训练编剧,在奖励计算时使读者固定,并瞄准多种原有的吊带而不是新设计的内存架构. 如果编剧和答案模型一起优化,更好的答案可以来自阅读改进而不是记忆改进. 表1总结了区别。

blocks.en: State separation also appears outside memory-specific agents. CodeDelegator separates persistent orchestration state from ephemeral execution sandboxes to prevent debugging traces and intermediate failures from polluting long-horizon planning context ( Fei et al., 2026a ) . Our setting has a related systems requirement: candidate rollouts must write to isolated banks, while only the selected bank persists across windows. Unlike CodeDelegator, however, our separation is used for on-policy credit assignment over memory writes rather than role-specialized code execution.
blocks.zh: 国家分离也出现在记忆特定代理人之外. 代号代表将持久管弦状态与麻黄执行沙盒区分开来,以防止调试痕迹和中间故障污染长视距规划背景(Fei等人,2026a ). 我们的设置有一个相关的系统要求:候选人的推出必须写给孤立的银行,而只有选定的银行坚持跨窗口。 然而,与代码代管人不同的是,我们的分离被用于政策信用分配而不是记忆书写,而不是角色专用代码执行.

blocks.en: 2.3 Why ordinary outcome-only RL is insufficient
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 为什么普通的只结果的RL是不够的

blocks.en: LLM RL commonly assigns a scalar reward to a whole completion. PPO stabilizes policy updates with a clipped surrogate ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) , while GRPO replaces a learned critic with a baseline estimated from grouped samples ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . This works well when the completion is a single solution and the final verifier is informative. A memory trajectory violates both assumptions.
blocks.zh: LLM RL通常会给整个完成分配一个scalar奖励. PPO用剪接的代孕剂稳定政策更新(Schulman等人,2017年),而GRPO则用分组样本估计的基线来取代一位有学识的批评家(Shao等人,2024年). 当完成是一个单一的解决办法,而最后的核查者是信息丰富的时,这项工作就很有效。 记忆轨迹违反两种假设.

blocks.en: A write in an early session may matter only when a much later question asks about it, so most writes receive no direct evidence. Giving the final QA score to every write rewards irrelevant actions and penalizes correct writes that co-occur with one bad action. Binary exact match often makes every rollout in a small GRPO group receive the same score, producing zero advantage and no task gradient; this has also been observed in memory-grounded QA ( He et al., 2026 ) . Jointly improving the answer agent can raise QA accuracy while the bank remains incomplete or noisy. An action changes the bank seen by later actions, so examples are not independent prompts. One write may invoke one LLM call while another invokes several, so a row-level baseline can weight call count rather than decision quality. Recall-only rewards can favor excessive storage.
blocks.zh: 早期的写作只有在一个很晚的提问中才会重要,所以大多数写作都没有得到直接的证据. 将最终的QA分数给予每个写作奖赏无关紧要的行动,并惩罚正确的写作,即与一个坏的行动共同登场. 二进制精确匹配经常使小的GRPO组中的每一次推出都获得相同的分数,产生0的优势,没有任务梯度;这也在基于内存的QA(He等人,2026年)中被观察到. 联合改进答题代理可以提高质评的准确性,而银行则仍然不完整或吵闹. 一个动作会改变后期动作所看到的银行,所以示例不是独立的提示. 一种写法可能引用一个LLM调用,另一种则引用几个调用,所以一个行级基线可以加权调用计数而不是决定质量. 只有召回的奖励会有利于过度存储.

blocks.en: The distinction between outcome and process supervision is well established in reasoning ( Lightman et al., 2023 ) . Memory writing needs a related but domain-specific decomposition. We do not label a hidden reasoning chain. Instead, we supervise observable consequences of each bank mutation: whether the introduced fact remains recoverable, whether irrelevant text was stored, and whether later cross-chunk answers recover the evidence contributed by that chunk.
blocks.zh: 在推理中,结果和过程监督的区别是明确的(Lightman等人,2023年)。 内存书写需要相关但针对域的分解. 我们不给隐藏的推理链贴标签。 相反,我们监督每个银行突变的可观察到的后果:引入的事实是否仍然可以恢复,是否存储了无关的文本,以及后来的交叉回答是否收回该块提供的证据。

blocks.en: 3.2 Data hierarchy
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 数据等级

blocks.en: An interaction sequence contains chronological sessions. Each session contains turns (one request and its response). A chunk is one harness write input, usually about ten turns, and never crosses a session boundary. A window is up to five consecutive chunks processed in one RL step and may span session boundaries.
blocks.zh: 交互序列包含时间顺序会话. 每场会议都有回合(一次请求及其答复)。 一个块就是一个拉带写输入,通常大约10个转弯,从不跨越会话边界. 窗口在一个 RL 步骤中处理最多5个连续块,并可能跨越会话边界。

blocks.en: 3.3 Memory writing as an MDP
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 内存写入为 MDP

blocks.en: For chunk t t , let M t M_{t} be the persistent memory bank and x t x_{t} the raw interaction chunk. The policy receives a harness-generated prompt containing x t x_{t} and selected information from M t M_{t} , then produces one or more structured LLM outputs a t a_{t} . The harness executes those outputs and creates the next bank: s t \displaystyle s_{t} = ( M t , x t , h ) , \displaystyle=(M_{t},x_{t},h), a t \displaystyle a_{t} ∼ π θ ( ⋅ ∣ s t ) , M t + 1 = T h ( M t , a t ) , \displaystyle\sim\pi_{\theta}(\cdot\mid s_{t}),\quad M_{t+1}=T_{h}(M_{t},a_{t}), (1) where h h denotes the harness configuration. The state lives primarily in the external bank, not in a continuous model context. Every LLM call may start from a fresh prompt, but the decisions are sequential because the bank carries their consequences.

This creates two training requirements: rollouts from one candidate must write to an isolated bank copy, and later windows must start from a bank the policy itself produced, not an annotation-derived ideal bank.
blocks.zh: 这就产生了两项培训要求:从一名候选人开始,必须写给一个孤立的银行副本,后来的窗口必须从银行开始,从政策本身开始,而不是从注释产生的理想银行开始。

blocks.en: 3.4 Three-model separation
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 三模式分离

blocks.en: The policy (Hy3-30B-A3B) sees the harness write prompt and produces all memory-write outputs; it is the only model trained in Stage 2. The answer model sees the question and the retrieved memory block, and reads what the bank exposes. The judge sees the question, answer, reference, and rubric, and assigns semantic credit. The answer model never sees the reference or rubric. The judge never sees the retrieved memory block. Freezing both makes the memory bank the only changing component in the reward path.
blocks.zh: 该政策(Hy3-30B-A3B)认为吊带写得迅速,并产生所有内存-写字输出;它是第2阶段唯一训练过的模型. 答案模型看到问题和检索到的内存块,并读出银行曝光的内容. 法官看问题、回答、参考和标题,并分配语义学功劳。 答案模型从未看到参考或标题. 法官从来没有看到 检索的内存块。 冻结两者使记忆库成为奖励路径中唯一变化的组件.

blocks.en: 4 Two-Stage Training
blocks.zh: 4 双阶段培训

blocks.en: 4.1 Why two stages
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 为什么是两个阶段

blocks.en: Direct RL from a generic instruction model wastes samples on protocol failures: malformed JSON, wrong operation names, missing fields, and invalid multi-stage control flow. Conversely, pure distillation teaches the model to follow a strong teacher but cannot rank the many valid memory representations by downstream usefulness. OPD learns how to act inside each harness, with dense token-level supervision on the student’s own prompts and outputs. RL learns which valid actions produce useful banks.
blocks.zh: 从通用指令模型中直接提取的关于协议故障的废物样本:JSON格式错误,操作名称错误,缺失字段,以及无效的多阶段控制流. 反之,纯蒸馏则教模型跟随强师,但不能通过下游的有用性来排列许多有效的记忆表达. 学生发展办公室会学习如何在每条绳索内行动,同时对学生自己的提示和产出进行密集的象征性监督。 RL学习哪些有效行动产生有用的银行.

blocks.en: 4.2 Stage 1: Memory on-policy distillation
blocks.zh: 4.2 第一阶段:政策记忆提炼

blocks.en: Chronologically ordered interaction sequences are segmented into chunks while preserving session boundaries. Chat emphasizes personal facts and preference changes; Working emphasizes tasks, decisions, deadlines, and organizational context; Coding emphasizes repositories, files, commands, implementation decisions, and changing technical state. Each chunk is paired with the harness state produced by preceding student writes, so OPD supervision follows the state distribution encountered during deployment.
blocks.zh: 按时间顺序排列的交互序列在保留会话边界的同时被分割成块. Chart强调个人事实和偏好变化; 工作强调任务,决定,最后期限,和组织背景; 编码强调寄存器,文件,命令,执行决定,以及不断变化的技术状态. 每个块都与之前的学生写作产生的绳索状态对齐,因此OPD监督跟踪部署时遇到的状态分布.

blocks.en: Each OPD row advances one (sequence, harness configuration) snapshot chain by one chunk. The rollout restores the selected parent bank M t − 1 M_{t-1} , invokes the unmodified harness write path, routes every harness LLM call to the student, applies the student’s operations to produce a candidate M t M_{t} , and promotes one candidate as the parent of the next chunk.

blocks.en: The teacher does not generate a separate ideal trajectory. It scores tokens on the trajectory the student generated. Supervision is placed on student-visited prefixes, reducing the exposure mismatch of static teacher demonstrations ( Gu et al., 2024 ) . For memory writing, the benefit extends beyond token prefixes: the future prompts also contain memory states created by the student.

blocks.en: 4.3 Stage 2: Memory reinforcement learning
blocks.zh: 4.3 阶段 2: 记忆强化学习

blocks.en: RL starts from OPD step 375 and executes the same harness configurations. For each window, eight rollouts begin from independent copies of the same parent bank. They write all chunks, are examined with reward questions, and receive per-chunk scores. The highest-scoring final bank is promoted to the next window in the same sequence. This is on-policy at two levels: tokens are sampled from the current writer, and future prompts are generated from banks produced by that writer.
blocks.zh: RL从OPD第375步开始,执行相同的吊带配置. 对于每个窗口,从同一母银行的独立副本开始推出8个版本。 他们写所有块, 检查与奖励问题, 并获得每吨分数。 得分最高的终极银行以相同的顺序晋级到下一个窗口. 这是在两个层面上的政策问题:从目前的作者中抽取符号,从该作者生产的银行中产生未来的提示。

blocks.en: 5 Reward Construction: From Failure Surfaces to Attributed Feedback
blocks.zh: 5 奖励建筑: 从失败表面到属性反馈

blocks.en: 5.1 Why benchmark questions are not enough
blocks.zh: 5.1 国家 为什么基准问题还不够

blocks.en: Using only final questions from a long-memory benchmark creates a low-density learning problem. A long interaction sequence may contain hundreds of useful facts but only a few questions. An unasked write receives no evidence, and a failed answer does not identify whether the cause was omission, bad wording, stale-state confusion, retrieval failure, or reader failure. Binary exact match further collapses semantically partial answers and can eliminate variance within a small GRPO group ( He et al., 2026 ) . We construct reward items from the failure surface of memory writing, not merely from a list of benchmark answers.
blocks.zh: 仅使用长期记忆基准中的最后问题就会产生低密度的学习问题. 一个长的相互作用序列可能包含数百个有用的事实,但只包含几个问题. 未询问的写作没有收到任何证据,一个失败的答案无法识别原因是否是遗漏,措辞差, stale-state混淆,检索失败,或读者失败. 二进制精确的匹配进一步崩溃了部分的解答,可以消除一个小的GRPO组内的差异(He等人,2026年). 我们从内存写作的失败表面构建奖励项目,而不仅仅是从基准答案列表中构建奖励项目.

blocks.en: 5.2 Chronological segmentation
blocks.zh: 5.2 时间分解

blocks.en: Interaction sequences retain session boundaries and chronological order. Each session is segmented independently into chunks of roughly ten turns, so a chunk never crosses a session boundary. The resulting chunks are flattened into one chronological stream; up to five consecutive chunks form one RL window, which may span sessions. Windows from the same sequence are consumed in order, and the selected policy-written bank from one window initializes the next. This preserves long-range state transitions while keeping each optimization step bounded.
blocks.zh: 交互序列保留会话边界和时间顺序. 每个会话被独立分割成大约10个转弯的块,所以一个块从不跨越会话边界. 所产生的块被平整成一个按时间顺序排列的流;最多连续五个块组成一个RL窗口,可能跨越会话. 同一序列的Windows按顺序消耗,从一个窗口中选择的策略写银行将下一个初始化. 这保留了远程状态过渡,同时保持每个优化步骤的界限.

blocks.en: 5.3 Two annotation passes
blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 两张注释证

blocks.en: Local write quality and long-range memory utility require different context, so the two reward types are annotated in separate passes (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 本地写作质量和远程内存效用需要不同的上下文,因此两种奖励类型在单独的通行证中附加注释(表3).

blocks.en: Table 3: The two annotation passes and the reward each one feeds.
blocks.zh: 表3:两个注解通过,每个注解的奖励提供依据。

blocks.en: A per-chunk probe must test information that chunk t t itself introduced. Annotating chunk t t in isolation fails in two ways. Coreference: mentions such as “that project” or “the same reviewer” cannot be resolved, so the annotator cannot write self-contained questions about them. Novelty: the annotator cannot tell whether a statement is new in chunk t t or repeats something already established, so probes would credit chunk t t for facts it did not introduce. The extracted facts of chunks t − 1 t{-}1 and t − 2 t{-}2 supply the referents and the recently established state. They are given as facts rather than raw text and serve as context only: no probe is generated from them, and they earn no credit for chunk t t .
blocks.zh: 每吨探测器必须测试将 t 本身引入的信息。 孤立地标注块 t t在两个方面都失败了. 参照:提到诸如“该项目”或“同一审查员”是无法解决的,因此,注释员不能就这些项目写自成一体的问题。 小说: 注释者无法分辨一个声明是新成块 t 还是重复已经确定的东西, 因此, 探针会将它没有提出的事实归功于块 t t 。 所提取的块数 t − 1 t{} 1 和 t − 2 t{} 2 的事实提供了裁判员和最近建立的状态 。 它们是作为事实而不是原始文字提供的,仅作为上下文:没有从它们中产生任何探针,它们没有得到任何信用。

blocks.en: Dependencies that span more than a few chunks are covered by the cross-chunk outcome pass, so the PRM pass does not need the whole sequence. Full history also lowers annotation quality. In a controlled comparison on identical chunks, full-history annotation used 33 times more input tokens, while the two-chunk context produced 25% more proper nouns and 59% more numbers per extracted fact. With the full sequence in view, the annotator’s attention spreads away from the current chunk and its facts become more generic, which is the over-generalization failure (Section 5.4 ) that probes are meant to detect.
blocks.zh: 跨过几个块的依赖性被跨圆形结果通道覆盖,因此PRM通道不需要整个序列. 完整的历史也降低了注释的质量. 在对相同的块进行控制比较时,全史注释使用了33倍多的输入符,而双圆上下文每提取一个事实,生成25%的正名词和59%的数字. 从全过程来看,注释者的注意力从目前的块中分散开来,其事实变得更加笼统,即探测器意在探测的过度泛化故障(第5.4节)。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Construction of the Memory RL reward artifact. Each session is split independently into chunks of about ten turns, so chunks never cross session boundaries. The chronological chunk stream is then grouped into RL windows of at most five chunks; a window may span sessions. The per-chunk probe pass writes the PRM items for chunk t t . It reads the full text of chunk t t plus the extracted facts of chunks t − 1 t{-}1 and t − 2 t{-}2 , used only to resolve references and decide what is new. The cross-chunk outcome pass writes ORM items from the facts of the whole window and earlier history. Structural filters and a synthetic-answer discriminability test produce the final artifact. The bottom row lists the rules that keep answer information out of the reward path (Section 5.6 ).
blocks.zh: 图2:记忆RL奖励文物建设. 每个会话被独立分割成大约10个转弯的块,因此块从不跨越会话边界. 然后按时间顺序将块流分组到最多五个块的 RL 窗口;窗口可能跨越会话。 每吨探测器的传球会写出PRM项目 它读了块 t t 的全文加上块 - 1 t{} 1 和 t - 2 t{} 2 的提取事实,仅用于解决引用和决定什么是新的. 跨圆果证从整个窗口和早期历史的事实中写出ORM项目. 结构滤波器和合成解答辨别性测试产生最终的文物. 下行列出让答案信息远离奖励路径的规则(第5.6节).

blocks.en: 5.4 Failure-surface taxonomy
blocks.zh: 5.4 故障表面分类

blocks.en: Table 4 lists the local failure modes. Cross-chunk questions add transition, coexistence, temporal, aggregation, multi-hop, and negative recall. This follows the capability decomposition exposed by LoCoMo and LongMemEval ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) , but the questions are generated during reward construction rather than copied from those benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 表4列出了本地失败模式。 交叉切入问题增加了过渡,共存,时间,聚合,多跳,以及负召回. 这与LoCoMo和LongMemEval暴露的能力分解有关(Maharana等人,2024年;Wu等人,2025年),但问题是在奖励建造过程中产生的,而不是从这些基准中复制。

blocks.en: Table 4: Per-chunk failure-surface probes.
blocks.zh: 表4:圆柱形故障表面探测器。

blocks.en: 5.5 Trap probes and the precision–recall trade-off
blocks.zh: 5.5 陷阱探测器和精确-召回权衡

blocks.en: Recall alone makes “store everything” attractive. We add trap probes about content that should not have entered long-term memory, such as an assistant’s generic encouragement. Their reference answer is that the bank contains no such record. If the writer stores the irrelevant statement, retrieval exposes it and the answer becomes incorrect. Traps and the bank-growth penalty are complementary. A size penalty discourages indiscriminate volume, while traps directly test semantic selectivity. A model cannot avoid the trap merely by compressing irrelevant text into a shorter entry.
blocks.zh: 光是召回就使“储存一切”具有吸引力。 我们加入了关于内容的陷阱探测器,这些内容不应该输入长期记忆,例如助理一般的鼓励。 他们的参考答复是,该银行没有这种记录。 如果编剧存储不相关的语句,则检索会曝光,答案就会变得不正确. 陷阱和银行增长惩罚是相辅相成的。 大小的判罚会抑制不分青红皂白的体积,而陷阱会直接测试语义上的选择性. 一个模型不能仅仅通过将无关的文本压缩到一个较短的条目来避免陷阱.

blocks.en: 5.6 Rubrics and gold-fact attribution
blocks.zh: 5.6 Rubrics和金矿的归属

blocks.en: Each probe and outcome question contains weighted credit points with semantic equivalents; explicit full-, partial-, and zero-credit bands; named distractors, including stale or superseded values; evidence chunk ids; and, for outcome questions, the source facts introduced by each evidence chunk. The answer judge performs semantic matching; code only aggregates returned credit.
blocks.zh: 每个调查和结果问题都包含具有语义等同的加权信用点;明确的全、部分和零信用段;指定分散注意力者,包括 stale 或 取代值;证据块ID;关于结果问题,每个证据块提出的来源事实。 解答判官执行语义匹配;代码只包含返回的信用集合.

blocks.en: Gold facts are visible only to the outcome judge. They are not inserted into the bank, retrieval query, or answer-model prompt. Facts from earlier windows may provide context but are marked history-only and cannot generate credit for a current chunk.
blocks.zh: 黄金事实只有结果法官才看得见。 它们不插入银行、检索查询或答题模式的提示。 早期窗口的事实可能提供上下文,但只标有历史,无法为当前块产生信用。

blocks.en: 5.7 Data verification
blocks.zh: 5.7 数据核实

blocks.en: Reward data must be tested as an instrument, not accepted because it is well-formed JSON. Four layers are enforced. Schema validity removes records with missing fields, unnormalized weights, illegal evidence ids, or illegal grading bands. Causal locality requires per-chunk probes to refer to the current chunk and cross-chunk questions to contain multi-chunk evidence when required. Rubric independence checks that credit points do not entail one another and that distractors represent real failure modes. Discriminability checks that the judge scores five synthetic answers per item in the expected order: reference and paraphrase receive full credit, a partial answer receives partial credit, and a distractor or refusal receives zero credit. In the pilot, faithful paraphrases retain an average score of 0.90.
blocks.zh: 奖励数据必须作为一种仪器进行测试,因为其JSON造型良好而不被接受. 执行四层. Schema有效性将记录去除缺失字段,非正常加权,非法证据ID,或非法分级带. Causal 位置要求每圆锥探测器在需要时参考当前块和跨圆锥的问题,以包含多圆锥的证据. Rubric独立检查,信用点不会相互影响,分散注意力者代表真正的失败模式. 辨别性检查,判断员按预期顺序对每件物品评分5个合成答案:参考语和解码语获得全额信用,部分答案获得部分信用,分散注意力者或拒绝者获得零信用. 在飞行员中,忠实的释法保留了0.90的平均分.

blocks.en: The structural pass keeps approximately 410k of 478k generated probes and 61k of 72k generated cross-chunk questions. To control judge cost, at most three positive probes and one trap are retained per chunk. The final artifact contains 164,576 positive probes, 8,599 traps, approximately 60.8k outcome questions, and 222,395 chunk-level gold-fact references.
blocks.zh: 结构传球保留了约410k的478k生成的探测器和61k的72k生成的交叉圆弹问题. 为了控制成本,每个块最多保留三个正探测器和一个陷阱。 最终的文物中包含164,576个正探测器,8,599个陷阱,大约60.8k个结果问题,以及222,395个块级的金事实参考.

blocks.en: Future work includes a random human audit with error categories and inter-annotator agreement; a train/evaluation near-duplicate and sequence-level leakage audit; per-scenario and per-failure-type calibration on strong and weak writers; and judge sensitivity to prompt, model, and repeated sampling.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作包括随机进行人的审计,包括错误类别和通知人之间的协议;列车/评价近似重复和序列级的泄漏审计;强弱作者的每例和每故障类型的校准;判断对即时,模型和重复采样的敏感性.

blocks.en: Probes give every chunk a local signal, so a sequence is not limited to a few terminal questions. Weighted rubrics with partial credit and distractors replace binary answer reward. Traps and the bank-growth penalty penalize over-storage. Gold facts attribute outcome evidence to evidence chunks instead of broadcasting one score. The answer model and judge are frozen, so reader improvements cannot hide writer defects. Continuous signals increase within-group resolution. Carrying the selected policy-written bank into the next window preserves cross-session effects. This is closer in spirit to process supervision than terminal-only RL ( Lightman et al., 2023 ) , but the supervised unit is an externally verifiable bank consequence rather than a subjective reasoning step.

We instead compute advantages per chunk, grouping by window, harness configuration, sequence, and chunk position: A i , t = s i ​ [ t ] − μ t σ t + ϵ , A_{i,t}=\frac{s_{i}[t]-\mu_{t}}{\sigma_{t}+\epsilon}, (7) where μ t \mu_{t} and σ t \sigma_{t} are the mean and standard deviation of s j ​ [ t ] s_{j}[t] over the chunk-level group G t G_{t} .
The best rollout can therefore differ from chunk to chunk: rollout 1 may have the highest score at chunk 2 while rollout 3 is best at chunk 4, and each chunk’s writes are reinforced or suppressed according to their own column (Figure 1 ).

blocks.en: 7 Training System
blocks.zh: 7 培训系统

blocks.en: Each harness is packaged behind a common interface: bank_open , write , search , bank_stats , and bank_close . The harness owns its native control flow. Harness-invoked LLM calls are routed to the policy endpoint and recorded at generation time with token ids, rollout log-probabilities, segment boundaries, and MoE routing. This follows the harnessed-agent-RL pattern in which the deploy-time loop is kept intact while model calls connect to a trainer ( Luo et al., 2025 ) . Retokenizing text after execution can diverge from the sampled stream, and recomputing rollout log-probabilities with the training engine destroys the intended importance ratio.
blocks.zh: 每个绑带被包裹在一个共同的接口后面:bank_open,写作,搜索,bank_stats,和bank_close. 绳索拥有其本土控制流. Harness-invoked LLM的电话被路由到政策端点,并在生成时用符号ID,推出日志概率,分区边界,和MOE的路由记录. 这遵循了被利用的特工-RL模式,即部署-时间循环保持完好无损,而模型呼叫则连接到一个训练员(Luo等人,2025年)。 执行后重新整理文本可以与抽样流相区别,用训练引擎重新计算推出日志的可能性会破坏预期的重要性比率.

blocks.en: Stage 2 starts from the OPD model, on Hy3-30B-A3B ( ∼ \sim 3B active parameters), using 16 nodes × \times 8 H20 GPUs (128 GPUs). A batch is 64 windows × \times 8 rollouts, or 512 trajectories. The objective is a PPO-style clipped surrogate with chunk-level GRPO advantages, aggregated as sequence mean then token mean, with no KL penalty. MoE routing from the rollout is replayed during training. The learning rate is 5 ​ e − 6 5\mathrm{e}{-6} , constant. The context is 28,672 prompt tokens plus 4,096 response tokens. The resulting post-RL model is released and evaluated as Hy-Memory-30B-A3B. Model, optimizer, schedule, and selected banks are checkpointed every 10 steps during training.
blocks.zh: 阶段2从OPD模型开始,在Hy3-30B-A3B(∼\sim 3B活性参数)上,使用16个节点×\times 8 H20 GPU(128 GPU). 一批是64个窗口×\时8个推出,或512个轨迹. 目标是一种PPO式的剪接代孕,具有块级GRPO的优点,汇总为序列表示然后符号表示,没有KL惩罚. 教育部从推出的线路在培训期间重新播放。 学习率为5 e − 6 5\ mathrm{e}{-6},恒定. 上下文为28,672个即时令牌加上4,096个响应令牌. 由此产生的RL后模型发布并评价为Hy-Memory-30B-A3B. 在培训期间,每10个步骤对模型、优化器、时间表和选定的银行进行检查。

blocks.en: 8 Experiments
blocks.zh: 8个实验

blocks.en: 8.1 Evaluation principles
blocks.zh: 8.1 评价原则

blocks.en: The evaluation changes only the memory writer. For each comparison, the harness version and prompts are fixed, retrieval configuration is fixed, and the answer model, judge, and other framework-side components are held fixed. Throughout this report, every reference to a DeepSeek Flash endpoint denotes DeepSeek V4.1 Flash . Decoding settings are matched where APIs permit, each writer builds its own bank from an empty state, and test examples and scoring rules are identical. This is necessary because memory quality is otherwise confounded with retrieval depth, reader capability, auxiliary-model capability, or a pre-existing bank.
blocks.zh: 评价只改变记忆作家. 对于每次比较,都固定了带版和提示,固定了检索配置,并固定了答案模型,判断器,以及其他框架侧组件. 纵观整个报告,每提到深搜索闪点,就表示深搜索V4.1闪点。 解码设置在API允许的情况下匹配,每个编目从空状态建立自己的银行,测试示例和评分规则完全相同. 这样做是必要的,因为除此之外,内存质量与检索深度,阅读能力,辅助模型能力或先前存在的银行都存在混淆.

blocks.en: For computational efficiency, every benchmark in the main four-harness matrix is evaluated on a fixed 20% subsample. The evaluated post-RL model is Hy-Memory-30B-A3B. Scores are deterministic outputs of the fixed evaluation pipeline; no missing judgment is imputed as zero. Each harness score is the equal-weight average of six metrics: LoCoMo Judge, LongMemEval, PersonaMem-v2, Travel SPS, Shopping PS, and Code Memory Bench (CMB). CMB is itself the equal-weight average of two repository QA evaluations. The overall score is the equal-weight average of the four harness scores.
blocks.zh: 为了计算效率,主要四合金矩阵中的每个基准都按20%的固定子样本进行评估。 被评价的RL后模型是Hy-Memory-30B-A3B. 得分是固定评价管道的确定性产出;没有遗漏的判断被推算为零。 每个吊带分数是6个度量衡的等重平均值:LoCoMo Judge,LongMemEval,PersonaMem-v2,Travel SPS,Shopping PS,和代码记忆座椅(CMB). CMB本身就是两个存储器QA评价的等重平均值. 总体得分是4个拉带分的等重平均值.

blocks.en: 8.3 OOD framework generalization
blocks.zh: 8.3 总体发展框架

blocks.en: EverMemOS is not part of OPD or RL training. It is included only at evaluation time as a held-out framework and is the strongest open-source community memory baseline in this evaluation. Hy-Memory-30B-A3B reaches 56.89, compared with 55.47 for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, 54.04 for Opus 5, and 52.30 for Hy3. This result separates model-level memory-writing skill from memorization of the training harness protocols.
blocks.zh: EverMemOS不是OPD或RL训练的一部分. 它仅在评价时才作为一个搁置框架列入,是本次评价中最强的开源社区记忆基线. Hy-Memory-30B-A3B达到56.89,而DeepSeek V4.1则达到55.47. Flash,54.04为Opus 5,52.30为Hy3. 这个结果将模型级的记忆写作技巧与训练带协议的记忆化分开.

blocks.en: 8.4 Future ablations and audits
blocks.zh: 8.4 (中文(简体) ). 今后的计划与审计

blocks.en: This report does not include controlled ablations of chunk-level versus window-level GRPO, gold-fact attribution versus broadcast ORM, positive probes versus probes plus traps, the bank-growth penalty, binary versus rubric-based rewards, RL initialization from OPD versus generic SFT, or single-harness versus mixed-harness training. We leave these comparisons to future work. Additional reward-data audits should measure human–judge agreement, sensitivity to the judge model and prompt, score distributions across synthetic answer types, separation between strong and weak memory writers, and the fraction of zero-variance rollout groups before and after reward decomposition.
blocks.zh: 本报告不包括受控的块级对窗口级GRPO、黄金事实归属对广播ORM、正探头对探头加陷阱、银行增长惩罚、二进制对卢比奖、OPD对通用SFT的RL初始化,或单发性与混合性培训。 我们把这些比较留给今后的工作。 额外的奖励数据审计应该衡量人类-法官的一致、对裁判模型的敏感性和迅速性、合成答案类型的分数分布、强弱记忆写作者之间的分离以及奖励分解前后零变量推出组的一小部分。

blocks.en: 9 Engineering Lessons: Silent Failures
blocks.zh: 9 工程经验教训:无声失败

blocks.en: Several failures looked healthy until an invariant was checked. A bank that did not persist across windows still left files on disk and produced nonzero rewards; the check is to reopen a checkpointed bank and verify a known record before training. A teacher that returned no top- k k values still returned successful requests, but OPD gradients were zero; missing teacher fields must raise, and teacher-token coverage must be monitored. When the per-chunk mapping was absent, a fallback broadcast one score to every segment; missing chunk-to-segment mappings must raise. A configuration omitted from a hard-coded schedule still had valid artifacts on disk; schedule manifests must be audited against the declared harness set. String rules that graded semantics produced a plausible aggregate reward; semantic conditions belong in judge rubrics, not substring code. A “read all” that silently paginated made the bank entry count plateau at a default limit; pagination and token accounting must be tested explicitly. Failed writes checkpointed as empty were marked complete; platform faults must be retryable and excluded from denominators. Sandboxes that shared a trajectory identity completed requests attached to the wrong rollout; every request must validate bank and trajectory identity. Malformed output treated as an environment error made bad actions disappear from training; policy mistakes should remain valid low-reward trajectories.
blocks.zh: 有几个故障看起来是健康的,直到检查了无变化剂。 一家没有横跨窗户的银行仍然把文件留在磁盘上,产生非零奖励;支票是重新开放一个检查站的银行,并在培训前核实已知记录。 一个未返回顶级- k k 值的老师仍然返回成功的请求, 但是 OPD 梯度为 0; 缺失的老师字段必须提高, 并且必须监控老师脚本覆盖 。 当每块绘图缺失时,一个倒计时向每个段播放一个分数;缺失的块到块绘图必须提高. 硬编码时间表中省略的配置在磁盘上仍然有有效的文物;时间表清单必须对照已申报的套装进行审计。 将语义分级的字符串规则产生了一个可信的汇总奖励;语义条件属于法官的语义,而不是次字符串代码. 静静地“阅读所有”使银行进入计算处于默认限度;必须明确测试标记和符号核算。 检查无效, 因为空的已标记完成; 平台断层必须可重试, 并且排除分母 。 共享轨迹身份的沙盒在错误推出时完成附加请求;每个请求都必须验证银行和轨迹身份。 错误的产出被视为环境错误,使不良行动从培训中消失;政策错误应仍然是有效的低回报轨迹。

blocks.en: The governing rule is: a bad policy action must receive low reward; a platform failure must not be misrepresented as policy behavior.
blocks.zh: 治理规则是:不良的政策行动必须获得低回报;平台失败绝不能被误认为政策行为.

blocks.en: 10 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 10 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Attribution is evidence-based rather than counterfactual: recovered gold facts do not prove that a specific write caused an answer. Credit is truncated across optimizer steps, so earlier-bank errors cannot receive retrospective gradient. One-vote grouping fixes the baseline, but multi-call chunks can still carry more loss mass. Rubric rewards reduce sparsity but require human-agreement and judge-sensitivity checks. The reward artifact covers Chat, Working, and Coding but not every long-term-memory workload; EverMemOS is only one held-out framework. The primary matrix uses deterministic 20% subsamples, so 0.01–0.02 point margins are not statistically significant; repeated training seeds remain future work. Finally, pooled scores can hide whether gains come from extraction, update, deletion, reconciliation, or retrieval-facing representation.
blocks.zh: 归咎是基于证据而不是反事实:收回的黄金事实不能证明具体写作引起答案. 信用通过优化步骤截断,因此早银行错误不能得到追溯梯度. 一票制分组可以固定基线,但多呼的块仍然可以携带更多的损失质量. 鲁布里克奖赏减少麻痹,但需要人力协议和法官敏感性检查。 奖励的文物覆盖 聊天、工作、编码,但并非每个长期工作量;EverMemOS只是一个搁置的框架。 主要矩阵使用确定性20%的子样本,因此0.01-0.02点差值在统计学上并不重要;重复培训种子仍然是未来的工作。 最后,集合计分可以隐藏来自提取、更新、删除、对账或检索的表示所产生的收益。

blocks.en: 11 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 11 结论

blocks.en: Memory writing is a long-horizon control problem over an external state, not merely a summarization prompt. Hy-Memory-30B-A3B first learns to operate real memory harnesses through on-policy distillation, then optimizes the answerability and selectivity of the banks it creates through Memory RL. The central technical contribution is the reward interface: failure-driven probes make supervision dense, cross-chunk questions measure downstream utility, gold facts attribute that utility to source chunks, traps and growth penalties close the store-everything shortcut, and chunk-level GRPO compares actions at the correct decision boundary.
blocks.zh: 记忆写作是对一个外部状态的长视距控制问题,而不只是一个归纳提示. Hy-Memory-30B-A3B首先通过政策蒸馏来学习操作真实的内存拉带,然后通过记忆RL来优化其创建的银行的可答性和选择性. 中央技术贡献是奖励界面:故障驱动的探测器使监管变得密集,交叉的提问测量了下游的效用,黄金事实将效用归属于源块,陷阱和生长惩罚关闭了存储-所有快捷键,块级的GRPO比较了正确的决定边界上的动作.

blocks.en: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B ranks first on Mem0, Hy-Memory, MemOS, and held-out EverMemOS. On fixed 20% benchmark subsamples, it averages 55.49% across six metrics and four harnesses, ahead of Claude Opus 5 at 54.62%, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at 53.64%, and the Hy3-A3B base checkpoint at 47.66%. The OOD EverMemOS result provides the clearest margin over Opus 5 (+2.86 points). Together, these results support memory writing as a transferable model capability rather than a collection of framework-specific prompt heuristics.
blocks.zh: Hy-Memory-30B-A3B在Mem0,Hy-Memory,MemOS以及被搁置的EverMemOS上排名第一. 在固定的20%基准子样本中,平均有55.49%的6个公尺和4个吊带,领先于Claude Opus 5,54.62%,DeepSeek V4.1 闪电53.64%,Hy3-A3B基地检查站47.66%. OOD EverMemOS结果为Opus 5(+2.86分)提供了最清晰的比值. 这些成果共同支持内存书写,将其作为可转移的模型能力,而不是收集特定框架的即时热量。
